title: Delegation tokens not wired into CoAP: no /groups/{gid}/tokens, no presentation path, no 4.03 delegation_invalid (spec 18.8.6)
description: Spec 12-apps.md 18.8.6: receivers MUST verify the full delegation chain (delegator role, scope limits); token issuance POST /groups/{gid}/tokens; presentation via delegation field in /groups/invite; validation failure responds 4.03 {error: delegation_invalid, reason: ...}. Classification: divergent (crypto library complete and vector-tested, zero CoAP wiring). Evidence: python/src/lichen/crypto/delegation_tokens.py:36-100,221-398 (scope bitmap 0x01/02/04/08/10, ADMIN_DELEGATABLE_SCOPE 0x13, COSE_Sign1 build/parse with byte-exact protected header 47a1013a00010000, verify_delegation_token); 13 vectors test/vectors/delegation_tokens.json consumed by ~35 tests (python/tests/crypto/test_delegation_tokens.py, test_delegation_tokens_vectors.py). Missing: no tokens resource anywhere, groups_invite.py parse_invitation consumes no delegation field, verify steps kid-known-owner/admin and seq cache are caller-supplied params, failure strings never emitted on the wire. Only external consumer is RPL prefix delegation (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_manager.py:441-664). Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/groups_invite.py (accept + verify delegation field, emit 4.03 delegation_invalid), new tokens resource; Rust/C parity after. Refs R-12-072, R-12-073, R-12-074, R-12-075.
